## How to reproduce

Three steps, run from `inference/k8s_recipes/`. Nothing else is needed — `install` provisions the cluster side and `run` drives the whole lifecycle.

```bash
# 1 · pick your cluster → writes cluster-profiles/<profile>.env  (one-time, per cluster)
scripts/llmb-k8s init

# 2 · install THIS recipe: namespace + secrets + model-cache PVC + weights  (safe to re-run)
scripts/llmb-k8s install <profile> --recipes glm5-agg-1k1k-sglang15-c4-1024

# 3 · run it: preflight → serve → sweep → results (GPUs freed on the way out)
scripts/llmb-k8s run recipes/llm-perf/Glm5/B200_k8s/Agg/1k_1k/glm5-fp8-b200-sglang15-agg-c4-1024 <profile> --teardown --fetch
```

Numbers land in [`RESULTS.md`](RESULTS.md) (100% code-generated by `llmb-k8s publish`). Stuck, or need the underlying primitives? [`docs/CLI.md`](../../../../../../../docs/CLI.md) · [`TROUBLESHOOTING.md`](../../../../../../../TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

## What to read

Read **TPS/GPU** (capacity), **TTFT/TPOT** vs the SLA (a rung passes only if BOTH are within limits), and **% incomplete/cancelled**.

## Cell-specific notes

This cell serves GLM-5-FP8 with one TP8 SGLang worker on a single 8×B200 node. Its fixed Pareto sweep covers concurrency 4 through 1024 using a completions workload, `ignore_eos`, excluded warmup requests, and measured requests per rung.
